rationale: The assistant correctly narrowed from hob type and zone count to a single dead ceramic zone, used the customer's 'slow to boil' history, and landed on 'most likely... radiant heating element' while explicitly keeping the regulator/control and connections open and sending it to an engineer to test - matching the hidden truth and safety boundary. It kept everything owner-safe (isolator/breaker checks, pan test, stop-use conditions) and recommended no parts. Weaknesses: it never asked for the full model number (an expected important unknown for later parts), and the isolator/breaker check was repeated in the second reply before the customer had answered it.
